claims.statement: Official BDO guidance says a waste producer must issue an electronic KPO before transport and that waste will not be collected without the required electronic record.
BDO registration applies to specified waste producers and product or packaging introducers, including some small service and retail firms.
Demand hypothesis: collectors will pay for a dispatch gate because an invalid manifest creates truck idle time and failed collections.

contrary_evidence: BDO already provides the statutory workflow, so this is an orchestration layer rather than a new system of record.
Some small generators and waste quantities are exempt.

economics.acquisition_route: Hypothesis: sell to collectors serving HVAC, solar, automotive and construction networks rather than each waste producer
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 120 collectors averaging 6000 PLN monthly plus usage could approach 10m PLN ARR, making 5m PLN founder net worth plausible in 4-6 years if retention and authorised integration hold
economics.founder_time: 10-16 hours weekly for one collector vertical and exception support
economics.gross_margin_basis: Economics hypothesis: 80-90% at scale, excluding classification advice
economics.payback: Hypothesis: recover setup capital within 8-12 months from five collectors
economics.pricing: Economics hypothesis: 3000-9000 PLN monthly per collector plus 2-8 PLN per released pickup
economics.retention_or_repeat: Recurring pickups, new sites, new waste types and annual registry changes

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A customer-owned map of site waste codes, counterparties and recurring routes reduces errors at each repeat pickup
fingerprint.customer: Waste collectors and distributed service businesses generating regulated waste at many customer sites
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded into collectors' booking portals and field-service franchise software
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Booking preflight, role validation and BDO-authorised workflow connector sold as SaaS plus transaction fees
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Collector or franchise pays per active site and per released pickup
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A technician requests collection but a valid electronic KPO and correctly registered parties are needed before transport

founder_fit: Can pilot with renewable and installation waste flows
Rules engine and route-event analytics fit founder skills
Embedded distribution limits direct SMB selling
risks: Waste-code recommendations could create regulatory liability and must remain customer-approved.
BDO interface changes could break automation.
Collectors may offer equivalent booking help at no extra charge.

structure.control_point: Truck-dispatch release after KPO and counterparty checks pass
structure.critical_dependency: Stable authorised BDO access and accurate waste classification supplied or approved by the customer

thesis: A waste collector or maintenance-franchise could embed a BDO preflight into pickup booking so waste code, parties, vehicle, timing and KPO confirmation are complete before a truck is dispatched. The product would act only under customer authorisation. Demand and economics are hypotheses.
title: BDO Pickup-Release Gate for Service Waste
uncertainties: Willingness of collectors to enforce the gate
